summary.plain: A rectangular tank holding 65 cubic metres of liquid scintillator, split into 512 separate cells and laced with gadolinium to catch neutrons, sitting 18 metres from the ISIS accelerator's beam stop.
summary.technical: Rectangular high-resolution liquid-scintillation calorimeter, 56 t total mass, 65 m³ active liquid-scintillator volume (75% vol. paraffin oil, 25% vol. pseudocumene, 2 g/l PMP wavelength shifter) optically segmented into 512 independent central modules with gadolinium loading between module walls for thermal-neutron capture; located 17.7 m from the ISIS beam-stop target at 100 degrees to the proton beam.

technology.quote: The liquid scintillator volume is optically separated into independent modules by an optical segmentation of double lucite sheets. ... gadolinium coated paper has been put between the acrylic walls for an efficient detection of thermal neutrons.
technology.value: Segmented liquid-scintillation calorimeter with gadolinium-loaded module walls for neutron capture
